titolo: datasette-charts 0.2a0 adds Datasette Agent integration and new chart features
descr: The pre‑release adds chat‑driven chart creation, a decade time unit, and improved line chart rendering.
paragrafi: Simon Willison announced the 0.2a0 pre‑release of the datasette-charts plugin on 24 November 2026.
The update integrates the plugin with Datasette Agent, letting users request charts via chat and open them in the chart builder panel.
The release also introduces a new decade time unit for columns spanning centuries and changes line charts to connect points across skipped buckets.
The GitHub release notes confirm seven commits since the previous tag and note the verified GPG signature of the commit.
perche: For AI users, the integration means faster, conversational data visualisation without manual chart setup. Developers of free or locally hosted tools gain a ready‑made plugin that works with existing Datasette Agent setups, expanding functionality without additional code.
